_comment: Hand-authored RE input for the script-globals subsystem (the despawn-global
MP-cars-in-SP fix). Unlike the native table, these anchors are NOT resolved by
the crossmap join -- they are version-specific machine addresses reverse-
engineered once per game build from the PS5 eboot with a disassembler, then
baked into a generated header by devtools/generators/generate_script_globals_header.py.
Set each anchor's "addr" to the absolute live virtual address (the eboot maps
at its fixed link base with no ASLR slide, so the disassembler vaddr is the
live VA). Leave it null until RE'd; a null anchor emits 0 and the runtime
latches FAILED rather than dereferencing null. See docs/script-globals-design.md.
_targetIdComment: Both the globals base and global indices are validated per title; never infer compatibility from a shared content version.

despawnGlobalIndex.note: Live bytecode scan on PPSA04263 01.010.002 independently returned 4520961. The runtime writes only after an explicit vehicle spawn arms the capability.

prologueGlobalIndex.note: Unset for 01.010.002; Skip Prologue remains disabled.

anchors.name: GLOBALS_BASE
anchors.lead: Live-verified PPSA04263 01.010.002 globals pointer table. The resolved block 17 and despawn slot were readable and the slot was writable with value 0 before injection.
method: Matched the PPSA04263 01.010.002 accessor bytes against its normalized executable.
Fail-closed read-only validation on PID 1346 observed 15 plausible pointers and 49 null entries, resolved block 17, and confirmed the target slot was writable without changing it.
A separate read-only live bytecode scan independently resolved global index 4520961.
